body:
### ✨ Improvements

- **Consistent document tools**: Document previews, shortcuts and command search share the same format and loading-state rules, including PowerPoint slideshow availability.
- **Consistent loading messages**: Image, HTML, Office and Canvas previews use a shared loading presentation and resolve the document-kind label before display.
- **Image controls**: Zoom and navigation controls occupy a separate area below the image in normal and full-screen views, including small images.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Closing another tab**: Keep the current document selected when closing a tab to its left, instead of unexpectedly opening a different preview.
- **Windows image folders**: Monitor folder availability without enumerating its contents, while keeping file-content change detection separate.
- **Repeated image loading**: Automatic refresh preserves unchanged images instead of discarding their preview repeatedly. Manual reload and real file changes still refresh the image.
- **Image loading completion**: Background image loading requests a new frame when its result becomes available; a full loading queue remains retryable instead of displaying a permanent failure.
- **Tab group naming**: Confirming, cancelling or dismissing a group-name popup releases its input focus, and removing the last group member clears any remaining rename state.
- **Unavailable document modes**: PDF and Office documents reject unsupported code-only and split modes consistently across menus, shortcuts and commands.

- **Embedded Office font safety**: Reject unsafe embedded-font names before native Word and PowerPoint preview conversion can write outside its font folder.

### 🔧 System

- Updated compatible dependencies used by the application and screenshot tooling.

### Known limitations

- The original reports of approximately 30-second image loading and intermittent missing-image messages are not fully resolved. This release fixes confirmed refresh/queue/wakeup paths; remaining cases are tracked in [#385](https://github.com/HiroyukiFuruno/KatanA/issues/385).
- Closing HTML or Office documents during an upstream synchronous load can still stall. Loaded-document close fixes do not imply that every original freeze is resolved; follow-up is tracked in [#386](https://github.com/HiroyukiFuruno/KatanA/issues/386).
- The pinned KDV/KRR versions remain unchanged. Broader Office/PDF conversion latency, browser-level HTML fidelity and persistent converted-document caching are not claimed as fixed in this release.
